input.quote: the validity, interpretation and legal effect of this Agreement shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of New York, U.S.A., applicable to contracts entered in and performed entirely within the State of New York, U.S.A. without regard to any conflict of law principles.
input.rationale: The General Provisions governing-law clause selects internal New York law (p0145) and requires all suits to be instituted in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York or the New York state courts, plus waiver of venue and forum non conveniens objections (p0146). That is our preferred position: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts sitting in New York. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision and no other dispute-resolution forum, so there is no offshore arbitration seat or foreign venue risk. No redline needed.
